```lean
induction n with d hd,
  { exact le_refl (n + 1) },
  { have h : 2 ^ d = 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 := by rw [pow_add, pow_one, mul_assoc],
    have h1 : 2 ^ (d - 1) * 2 + 1 ≤ 2 ^ d * 2 := by rw [h]; exact add_le_add_left (le_rfl) (le_refl _),
    rw [pow_add, pow_one, mul_assoc] at h1,
    exact le_trans h1 (mul_le_mul_right (le_of_lt (lt_iff_le_not_le.2 (le_zero_right _))) (le_rfl _)) }
```
